about: Curated, hand-written. Every shipped node has exactly one functional ROLE (what it does to the data), and every role belongs to one pipeline STAGE (where it sits in acquire -> prepare -> find -> quantify -> present). `scripts/_node_synopsis.py` merges this into codemap/node_synopsis.json and its check fails if a node is unassigned, assigned twice, or no longer exists. The registry `category` field is the palette grouping the GUI shows; a role is a finer, purpose-based cut (the 20 `enhancement` nodes split three ways here, the 12 `utility` nodes four ways). V4.00 (2026-10-05) adds PAGES: `pages` declares the typed page kinds of a Workspace in pipeline order, each role lists the kinds whose palette offers its nodes (`pages`), and `op_pages` overrides that per op; the GUI, the Workspace and the synopsis all read these through nodegraph.roles. The `free` kind (every node) is deliberately not listed: it is the absence of a filter.

acquire_and_organize.label: Acquire & organize
acquire_and_organize.description: Get pixels into the graph and arrange files, positions and channels into the Dataset the rest of the pipeline expects. No pixel values change.

prepare_image.label: Prepare the image
prepare_image.description: Operate on intensities and geometry so later steps see a cleaner, aligned, correctly shaped image. Output is still an image, with no new structure.

find_structure.label: Find structure
find_structure.description: Turn intensities into objects - masks, label regions, points, meshes - and convert between those representations.

quantify.label: Quantify
quantify.description: Measure, select, follow and compare objects and fields over time. Output is tables, scalars and derived fields.

control_and_present.label: Control & present
control_and_present.description: Shape how the graph executes and how results are seen: iteration, zones, grouping, routing, viewing and overlay.

input.label: Image Input
input.description: Bring files on, lay them along an axis, split or select positions and channels, and name an experimental condition as an output. No pixel values change.

refine.label: Image Refinement
refine.description: Denoise, correct, align, crop and project, then find structure: cleaned images and masks, labels and points, named as outputs for the processing pages.

process.label: Image Processing
process.description: Quantify structure over space and time: measurements, object fields, tracks, PIV and deformation fields, named as outputs for the analysis pages.

analyze.label: Analysis
analyze.description: Synthesize the outputs of refinement and processing pages: overlays, plots and tables, written out as figures, movies and TIFFs.

input_output.label: Input / output
input_output.description: Sources that bring a file onto the wire, checkpoints that bake and re-serve it, and sinks that write it back out as TIFF, movie, image sequence or figure.

dataset_and_channel_organization.label: Dataset & channel organization
dataset_and_channel_organization.description: Bookkeeping on the Dataset's axes without arithmetic on pixels: pick or split channels, stack files on the batch axis and fan them back out, lay files along one axis, merge Datasets, keep one specimen group of positions.

image_restoration.label: Image restoration
image_restoration.description: Recover the underlying signal: denoise (edge-preserving, non-local, variational, wavelet), deblur by deconvolution with a metadata-derived or learned PSF, and paint out dust and hot-pixel artefacts.

background_and_intensity_correction.label: Background & intensity correction
background_and_intensity_correction.description: Make intensities comparable across the field and across time: remove a background surface, flatten uneven illumination, correct bleaching or gain drift along T, and rescale or re-curve the intensity range (normalize, gamma, CLAHE).

image_filtering.label: Image filtering & feature enhancement
image_filtering.description: Linear and morphological filters that emphasise or suppress features at a physical scale: Gaussian blur, difference-of-Gaussians band-pass, unsharp sharpening, top-hat, grayscale morphology and the morphological gradient edge map.

registration_and_alignment.label: Registration & alignment
registration_and_alignment.description: Estimate and apply (or record) the transform that lines frames or files up: rigid drift correction over T, register-once/apply-to-all stabilization with several motion models, and stage-coordinate alignment of one file to another.

geometric_transformation.label: Geometric transformation
geometric_transformation.description: Move, cut or rescale the pixel lattice while the calibration follows: translate and rotate inside a fixed frame, crop by region or by frame selection, crop to another file's field, resample by a factor.

projection_and_stitching.label: Projection & stitching
projection_and_stitching.description: Collapse or join an axis: Z-projection to a single plane, T-stacking to one frame with a robust combiner, and M-stitching of multipoint tiles into one mosaic.

segmentation_and_labeling.label: Segmentation & labeling
segmentation_and_labeling.description: From intensities to regions: global, local and multi-level thresholds, the unified Segmentation node (threshold, watershed, StarDist, CellSAM), connected-component labeling, ROI rasterization, hand-drawn labelled regions pinned to a frame, and growing seed points into measurable label regions.

object_detection.label: Object detection (points)
object_detection.description: Find small bright or dark objects as sub-voxel Points rather than regions: LoG/DoG spot detection sized from the diffraction limit, and particle detection by local maxima or component centroids.

shape_and_distance_geometry.label: Shape & distance geometry
shape_and_distance_geometry.description: Geometry derived from existing structure: distance transforms, outward boundary bands, region outlines as points, closed surface meshes per label, and Voronoi territories linking seed points to arenas.

representation_transfer.label: Representation transfer
representation_transfer.description: Convert structure or attributes between the Voxel, Label, Point, Track, Mesh and Frame domains: label regions to centre points, meshes and point fields back to voxel rasters, and the two generic domain-transfer nodes.

measurement_and_statistics.label: Measurement & statistics
measurement_and_statistics.description: Numbers from objects: per-region and per-point intensity and shape measurements, derived per-object kinematics and neighbour metrics, gridded Eulerian object fields, point clustering, and reduction of any layer or column to one Global scalar.

object_filtering_and_selection.label: Object filtering & selection
object_filtering_and_selection.description: Keep or split objects by their measured columns: whole-label filtering with a histogram-chosen cut, and the If/Else split of a structure table into PASS and FAIL sets.

table_synthesis.label: Table synthesis
table_synthesis.description: Build new tables out of measured ones: Table Concat stacks the tables of several pages or variants with a condition column, Table Join adds another table's columns row by row on a shared key, and Table Aggregate summarises a column per group (mean, sem, count, ...).

tracking.label: Tracking
tracking.description: Follow objects through time: frame-to-frame linking by overlap or nearest neighbour, the multi-linker Track Objects node, and per-particle displacement, velocity and strain from an existing track membership.

motion_and_deformation_fields.label: Motion & deformation fields
motion_and_deformation_fields.description: Dense or gridded motion between frames without discrete objects: 2D digital image correlation, 3D digital volume correlation, particle image velocimetry, per-pixel optical flow, and accumulation of DVC increments into cumulative displacement and strain.

control_flow.label: Control flow
control_flow.description: Nodes that change how the graph runs rather than what it computes: Iterate and its hidden search step, the per-frame slice, and the Repeat and Simulation zone boundaries.

graph_structure.label: Graph structure
graph_structure.description: Pass-through markers with no effect on data: the Group Input/Output pair that bounds a reusable subgraph, and Reroute for tidy wiring.

visualization.label: Visualization
visualization.description: Look at results: the Viewer display sink, Overlay, which composites a second Dataset into this one's field on the microscope's own stage coordinates, and Experiment Canvas, the blank stage-spanning field that Overlays are chained onto when the files share no field.

plotting.label: Plotting
plotting.description: Charts of the measured tables, drawn with matplotlib as a true-colour picture the Viewer shows and Export Figure writes as PNG, SVG, PDF or TIFF: Plot XY draws one column against another, Plot Time Series one over the experiment's own clock (both optionally one figure per frame), Plot Distribution a column's spread per group, and Plot Heatmap a table summary on a grid or a Voxel layer's plane.

page_boundary.label: Page boundary
page_boundary.description: The V4 workspace's seams: Page Output names the Dataset wired into it as a variable of its page, and Page Input on a later page reads one by `<page>:<name>`. Pass-throughs at run time - the Workspace splices the upstream page in and the Input node disappears - so neither changes a pixel.
